title: Refunds policy
text:
[REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated.

| Payment method | Time to reach you |
| --- | --- |
| UPI | 1 to 3 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days |
| Net banking | 3 to 5 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours |
| Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |

title: Returns policy
text:
[RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.

title: Escalation and human handover
text:
[ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

title: Refunds policy
text:
[REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

title: Refunds policy
text:
[REF-6] Refund reference number
Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.

title: ZentroMart Plus membership
text:
[PLS-2] Benefits
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.

[RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

title: Returns policy
text:
[RET-4] Condition of returned items
Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.

title: Returns policy
text:
[RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

title: Returns policy
text:
[RET-8] Festive sale returns
Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.

title: About this knowledge base
text:
[KB-00.1] Which document wins
When two documents disagree, follow this order of precedence:

1. **Policy documents** (doc_type: policy) with status `current`.
2. **Agent guides** (doc_type: agent_guide).
3. **Help articles** (doc_type: help).
4. **FAQs** (doc_type: faq).
5. **Marketing pages** (doc_type: marketing). These describe benefits in general terms and never override a policy.


Documents marked `status: superseded` are kept for reference only. They apply only to the cases their successor document says they still cover.

title: About this knowledge base
text:
[KB-00.3] Business days
A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days.

title: Verifying the customer
text:
[IDV-2] How to verify
Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.
